sourceGroundedDiagnosis.classification: Concrete harness lifetime defect found in source; occurrence of its owner replacement in this run remains an inference.
observedSourceFacts: The b103 harness stores controller.document in _OwnedPdfViewer before awaiting target navigation and keeps reading that snapshot.
S02 font recovery can publish a replacement on the same document reference; publication disposes the old native document.
The locked native loadText returns null for a disposed document or an unloaded page. The first native page is measured before openFile returns.
The old close guard waits for only the initially captured owner, so it can miss a replacement owner.
sourceGroundedDiagnosis.missingRuntimeEvidence: The original raw report has no live published owner/generation identity at the failed loadText boundary; it does not directly prove which reload occurred.
sourceGroundedDiagnosis.repairUnderTest: Resolve the live published owner for each operation, verify its identity before/after native awaits, record every observed generation, and await all observed native closes after detach.
